cells.scene: A single cave explorer wearing helmet, headlamp and harness examines an underground rock passage with a rope over one shoulder.
An adult rambler with a small daypack and walking stick follows an easy countryside footpath through grassland.
A team of adults starts building a small wooden footbridge, timber and tools arranged beside a stream.
A hiker packs a raincoat and first-aid kit before leaving under currently clear skies, small distant rain cloud hints at preparation.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — pot-holer (n.洞穴探险者): A single cave explorer wearing helmet, headlamp and harness examines an underground rock passage with a rope over one shoulder.
TOP RIGHT — rambler (n.漫步者，散步者): An adult rambler with a small daypack and walking stick follows an easy countryside footpath through grassland.
BOTTOM LEFT — undertaking (n.任务，工作): A team of adults starts building a small wooden footbridge, timber and tools arranged beside a stream.
BOTTOM RIGHT — foresight (n.预见；深谋远虑): A hiker packs a raincoat and first-aid kit before leaving under currently clear skies, small distant rain cloud hints at preparation.
CROP SAFETY: each scene has 20% white margins inside its own quadrant. Top drawings fully end ABOVE 45% image height. Bottom-row heads, hair, thought bubbles and main objects begin BELOW 58% total image height. Nothing crosses midlines.
review_notes: Reviewed scene meanings, anatomy and crop containment. Cave and hiking equipment recognizable; all subjects remain within their quadrants.
